usedFor: Salesforce holds contacts, and Vonage texts them through your Vonage account when “New Contact” runs “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Salesforce, then “Send SMS” in Vonage
bestTemplate.why: A new contact gets a text sent through your Vonage account, using the phone number on the record.

watchOut: “New Contact” in Salesforce is polling, so “Send SMS” runs after a scheduled check.
